35319: Ellen McNulty leaves her New Jersey hamburger stand and heads west to pay a surprise visit to her son and his new bride. 35575: Amir and Sara are a young couple on their way to Melbourne to continue their studies. However, just a few hours before the departure of their flight, they are unintentionally involved in a tragic event.
35831: Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP) Malvika Chauhan battles time to obtain & solve the clues to solve the various murders occurring in the city.

37623: Puli joins the police force since he wants to avenge his father's murder at the hands of Al Saleem. He gets an opportunity to bring Al Saleem to justice after he saves the life of the PM of India.

38135: A man meets and falls in love with a beautiful woman. However, due to his violent background, her parents are against the relationship. After the couple shows no signs of breaking up, her mother has the man arrested.

On The Dark Side Of Dreams, A New Terror Takes Shape.
38647: A family moves their troubled daughter to a small town, where people suspect she is responsible for a series of mysterious deaths. Fearing something evil followed them, the tormented parents must do whatever it takes to save their daughter.

Have No Fear, It's the Comedy Smash of the Year!
39159: The outbreak of World War I places Scots officer Geoffrey Richter-Douglas in an uncomfortable position. The Great War's most explosive moment!
39415: A man remembers forty-eight crucial hours in his life when, as a child, he visited his mother, the favorite woman of an important politician, in a bordello owned by him, right before some important political changes in 1937 Brazil. In those hours, he discovers his own sexuality.
39671: Luc and his English friend Chris take a taxi to go home after partying hard all evening in Paris. At destination, they run away without paying the fare. They got the wrong driver for this... 39927: When a reclusive, enigmatic millionaire dies suddenly on the Riviera, his press agent begins to investigate his employer's shady past.
Robert Mitchum is the hunted... Europe is the hunting ground!

Gangsters who’ve come to kidnap Happy and her husband, pick up the wrong Happy, while Guddu and his wife Happy are escorted to a university to deliver a lecture.

Big and Gay as the Gay White Way!

One Girl with Courage is a Revolution

The genius behind The Beach Boys and the California sound.
44279: A thriller centered on a young boxer trying to distance himself from his father's gangster past and the relationship with his trainer.
44535: Superhero Captain America battles the evil forces of the archvillain called The Scarab, who poisons his enemies and steals a secret device capable of destroying buildings by sound vibrations.

Criminal Masterminds? Don't Bank On It.

The secret will never leave the ship

Two make love. Three make a baby.

When love doesn't last, the stories do.

Yelena, child of the Foreign Trade Union

You'll shriek with horror!…as you watch his victims take a diabolical roller-coaster ride to bloody death

The devil made her do it... not that she minded...

She Outwitted the Law...but Yielded to Love!

GAY, MUSICAL COMEDY...SPARKLING WITH SPICY SITUATIONS!
